cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A uses precise timeline reconstruction to make B delay visibly disruptive, correcting B minimisation until an apology becomes easier than continuing the reconstruction.
confusable: A compensation claim would accept money; this A refuses replacement dinner in favor of an apology that ends the display.
comparison: Sock alternative is a visible physical sample; this one sets out missed journeys and a cold meal chronologically.
seedUse: Circled buses, delayed keys and takeaway receipt derive from D27-b; S03 supplies exact distinctions between elapsed minutes and their consequences.
